expected.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent with its own context. It does NOT see this conversation: give a complete standalone prompt. Returns only its final result. Runs in the background by default and returns a durable subagent id; you are notified when it settles; `send_message` continues the same child. Set `run_in_background: false` only when your next action depends on the result.

prompt.description: Complete, self-contained task; include everything the subagent needs.

expected.description: Like `subagent`, but the child inherits all completed turns of this conversation (not the current in-flight turn). Use when the subtask builds on existing context. Same background/notification/`send_message` behaviour as `subagent`.

prompt.description: The task; state only what is new.

expected.description: List your background subagents (id, label, status) to recall what you started — not to poll; you are notified on completion. Status: running = working now; idle = between turns; ready = stored only, resumable. The snapshot does not guarantee delivery; `send_message` does the real check. `send_message` works only for direct children (depth 1); deeper agents can only be targeted by `interrupt_agent`.

Send a message to a background subagent; it becomes its next turn. If the subagent is busy the message waits, so it cannot redirect work already underway. Returns only delivery confirmation, never the subagent's answer. A failure means it was NOT delivered.
